description: Audits, prioritizes, optimizes, and protects software development feedback loops across builds, tests, CI gates, caches, environments, dependency structure, and coding-Agent execution without silently weakening required engineering evidence.

changes: Add a hard P0-P5 priority ladder that separates trust failures, blocking no-evidence work, validation amplification, reuse problems, gate redesign, and architectural locality.

Add a staged governance sequence and same-tier opportunity ranking based on critical-path benefit, frequency, population, confidence, durability, effort, correctness risk, maintenance, and rollback difficulty.
Require every audit to select exactly one Next Best Intervention with expected benefit, evidence preservation, risk, rollback, validation, and a follow-up gate.
Add governance work-in-progress limits and stop conditions so feedback-loop governance does not become an unbounded engineering program.
